name: Venerable Warsinger

abilities.text: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, you may return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of damage ~ dealt to that player.

notes: X is the trigger's own amount (that-many = the combat damage this creature dealt to that player), used as the mvLE of the graveyard target.

issues: target creature card with mana value X or less ... where X is the amount of damage this creature dealt to that player — expected X = the combat damage dealt (e.g. 3), so a MV-2 creature card is a legal target — scripted filter mvLE={count:'that-many'}, but matchesFilter evaluates it as evalAmount(s, f.mvLE, ctrl, 0, source) with NO AmountCtx (src/engine/characteristics.ts:260), and 'that-many' resolves to ctx?.thatMany ?? 0 (characteristics.ts:156) — X is always 0, so only MV-0 creature cards are ever legal targets. Blind scenario confirms: Grizzly Bears (MV 2) stayed in the graveyard — CR CR 608.2 — X is determined by the value specified by the ability

you may return TARGET creature card — expected the target is chosen when the trigger is put on the stack; the 'may' is decided on resolution — scripted the targeted return is nested inside a 'may' effect, which mixes target selection with the optional decision

target creature card with mana value X or less ... where X is the amount of damage this creature dealt — expected X = combat damage dealt this trigger; a creature card of that mana value or less is a legal target — scripted mvLE:{count:'that-many'} lives inside the TARGET filter. Target legality goes through legal.ts:153 -> matchesFilter -> characteristics.ts:260, which calls evalAmount(s, f.mvLE, ctrl, 0, source) with NO AmountCtx, so 'that-many' falls through to ctx?.thatMany ?? ctx?.refs?.item.lastAmount ?? 0 = 0 (characteristics.ts:156). Effectively only mana-value-0 creature cards are ever legal targets. Blind scenario confirms: Grizzly Bears (MV 2) not returned after 3 damage — CR 608.2b, 601.2c

you may return target creature card — expected target chosen when the trigger goes on the stack, then optional on resolution — scripted 'may' wraps the return-from-graveyard with target:true — ordering is acceptable, but is moot given the mvLE=0 defect above — CR 601.2c
